writeup: Woot has a new Valken Tango thermal airsoft goggle set in Olive for $19.99. This is the dual-pane kit with interchangeable clear, gray, and yellow thermal lenses plus an Rx insert, identified as model 91456. Action Village lists the same Olive thermal Tango at $39.95, Airsoft Armory has the multi-lens set at $39.99 with one in stock, and Evike is at $49.95, so this is 49 percent and about $20 below the lowest verified store price. Stock shows 3+ left, with a purchase limit of 3 per customer.
